ACT LXIV OF 1975
ACT LXIV OF 1975
MALARIA
ERADICATION BOARD (REPEAL) ACT, 1975
An Act to repeal
Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 24th July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Malaria Eradication Board
(Repeal) Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Repeal, etc

ACT LXIV OF 1975
ACT LXIV OF 1975
MALARIA
ERADICATION BOARD (REPEAL) ACT, 1975
An Act to repeal
Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 24th July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. Repeal, etc.---(1) The
Malaria Eradication Board Ordinance, 1961 (XVIII of 1961), hereinafter referred
to as the Ordinance, is hereby repealed.
(2) Upon the repeal of the
Ordinance,-
(a) notwithstanding anything
contained in any contract or agreement or in the conditions of service, the
officers and other employees of the Malaria Eradication Board, hereinafter
referred to as the Board, shall stand transferred to the Federal Government on
such terms and conditions as may be laid down by the Federal Government ;
(b) all rights, properties,
assets, debts, liabilities and obligations of the Board shall be the rights,
properties, assets, debts, liabilities and obligations of the Federal
Government
(c) any contract made by the
Board before such repeal shall be deemed to have been made by the Federal
Government ; and
(d) all suits and other legal
proceedings instituted by or against the Board before such repeal shall be
deemed to be suits and proceedings instituted by or against the Federal
Government and may be proceeded or other wise dealt with accordingly.
(3) The Federal Government may,
for the purpose of removing any diffi culty in relation to the transfer and
other matters referred to in subsection (2), make such order as it considers
expedient and any such order shall be deemed to be, and given effect to, as
part of the provisions of this Act.
